caption:
If patience feels heavy tonight, read this

Allah speaks these words to His Prophet ﷺ. Read them slowly and let them settle your heart before you sleep.

Surah At-Tur 52:48

Save this for the night you need it most.

#sabr #patienceinislam #surahtur #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: Be patient [O Prophet] with your Lord’s decree, for indeed you are under Our [watchful] Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise (Surah At-Tur 52:48)
theme: comfort in patience / under Allah's watchful Eyes
